lines.text: Blanc and Noir are sitting down in front of the dorms.
Blanc in particular looks like death warmed over.
You don't look so good, Blanc.

lines.speaker: blanc_c
lines.text: I thought I was getting a little better,

lines.speaker: blanc_c
lines.text: but following Lumi around these past few days took a lot out of me.
We better hurry back to the hot spring, then.

lines.speaker: blanc_c
lines.text: We all know how much Lumi hates that place. How could I possibly ask her to go back there?

lines.speaker: blanc_c
lines.text: There must be some other way to replenish my luck.

lines.speaker: noir_c
lines.text: but Lumi called Pit Boss and I Mom and Dad.

lines.speaker: noir_c
lines.text: she sees the two of us differently.

lines.speaker: blanc_c
lines.text: But we're doing this all for Lumi, after all, so it's okay.

lines.speaker: blanc_c
lines.text: Don't ever forget that you and I are one.

lines.speaker: blanc_c
lines.text: Anyway, I suppose I should be glad.

lines.speaker: blanc_c
lines.text: Once I feel a bit better, let's go find Lumi and go to the hot spring.

lines.speaker: blanc_c
lines.text: considering that this is how things have turned out, I'm curious about something.

lines.speaker: blanc_c
lines.text: What kind of person do you think Lumi's older sister was like?

lines.speaker: noir_c
lines.text: There's no way we can know for sure, but...

lines.speaker: noir_c
lines.text: I don't think she was a good person.

lines.speaker: noir_c
lines.text: Lumi appears to be acting based on her subconscious memories,

lines.speaker: noir_c
lines.text: and I think it's safe to say that her reactions have not been warm and fuzzy.

lines.speaker: blanc_c
lines.text: I haven't known her for long,

lines.speaker: blanc_c
lines.text: but the Lumi I know from Snowfield is affectionate and full of curiosity,

lines.speaker: blanc_c
lines.text: To be honest, there aren't many Nikkes who don't come from troubled backgrounds,

lines.speaker: blanc_c
lines.text: but all I hope is that Lumi can find a little bit of happiness while we're out here.
I think she's already happier than she was.
She's gained a new sister. One that's affectionate towards her.
She's also found a caring mother.

lines.speaker: blanc_c
lines.text: And don't forget about a father who cuts a dashing figure.

lines.speaker: noir_c
lines.text: It's too bad that Blanc and I are playing different roles, but we've managed to form a complete family unit!
So let's seize the chance and head to the hot spring.

lines.speaker: blanc_c
lines.text: I'm willing to bet I'll get better faster if you and Noir stay close to me.

lines.speaker: noir_c
lines.text: Don't worry, I'm not going anywhere.

lines.speaker: blanc_c
lines.text: Hehe, I can really feel the "parental love" right about now.
With my left hand, I hold Blanc's hand,
Together, the three of us lie down and fall asleep, a charming facsimile of a family.
I wake up and feel a sense of emptiness around me.
Blanc and Noir are both gone,
replaced by a small note that said: "We're feeling much better now, off to the hot spring first!"
I leave the dormitory, with the clothes for changing and towels.
As I arrive at the hot spring, I find Blanc, Noir, and Lumi are together.

lines.speaker: blanc_c
lines.text: We ran into Lumi on the way here, so we brought her along.

lines.speaker: noir_c
lines.text: I'm so glad that she doesn't avoid me anymore.

lines.speaker: blanc_c
lines.text: If you would, give me your hand, Lumi.

lines.speaker: noir_c
lines.text: D-do you want to hold my hand as well?
Blanc and Noir each extend a hand towards me.
I approach Blanc and hold her hand.

lines.speaker: blanc_c
lines.text: Hehe, your hand is so warm, Dad. It feels nice.

lines.speaker: blanc_c
lines.text: Well, I think we're ready to head into the hot spring, wouldn't you say?
I approach Noir and hold her hand.

lines.speaker: noir_c
lines.text: Hehe, your hand is so warm, Darling. It feels nice.

lines.speaker: noir_c
lines.text: Well, I think we're ready to head into the hot spring, wouldn't you say?
I hold onto both Blanc and Noir's hands,
and we stand in a circle.

lines.speaker: blanc_c
lines.text: Well, I think we're ready to head into the hot spring, wouldn't you say?
and with a great sense of excitement, dip our feet into the water.

lines.speaker: blanc_c
lines.text: At long last, our luck is—!

lines.speaker: blanc_c
lines.text: Lumi is here with us, and we're a family.

lines.speaker: noir_c
lines.text: At least last time, I felt my luck getting recharged for a moment.
I think back on that day.
When Noir, Blanc, and Lumi went in together, they all felt something,
but they said that feeling disappeared the moment I stepped in.
It has to do with the number of people.

lines.speaker: noir_c
lines.text: Last time it was just Blanc, Lumi and myself who went in.

lines.speaker: blanc_c
lines.text: It's so nice being in the hot spring together with you.
I know, but recharging your luck is more important.

lines.speaker: noir_c
lines.text: but you have to promise that you'll join us next time.
step out of the hot spring...

lines.speaker: blanc_c
lines.text: It's like my luck is being replenished!
It feels a bit awkward standing to the side staring, so I turn my head to the side.

lines.speaker: noir_c
lines.text: my luck has been topped up to the brim.
Seems like you two are back to normal.

lines.speaker: blanc_c
lines.text: It's not just normal, Pit Boss.

lines.speaker: noir_c
lines.text: Like we could do 3 or 4 shows in a row.

lines.speaker: blanc_c
lines.text: It took a while, but we cracked the code behind the legend of the hot spring!

lines.speaker: blanc_c
lines.text: Apparently three was the magic number.

lines.speaker: blanc_c
lines.text: It could be that Lumi went in with her real parents,

lines.speaker: blanc_c
lines.text: The important thing is that we got our luck back and solved the legend of the hot spring!

lines.speaker: blanc_c
lines.text: And it's all thanks to you, Lumi.

lines.speaker: noir_c
lines.text: coming to the hot spring with you and getting to the bottom of this legend was so much fun.

lines.speaker: noir_c
lines.text: I feel like I've gained a new family member.

lines.speaker: noir_c
lines.text: I hope that you feel the same...

lines.speaker: blanc_c
lines.text: We may not have spent a lot of time together,

lines.speaker: blanc_c
lines.text: but do you think we can remain one big family?

lines.speaker: noir_c
lines.text: O-of course, if you'd prefer not to,

lines.speaker: blanc_c
lines.text: Lumi, can you give us your hand again?
Blanc and Noir hold Lumi's hand tightly

lines.speaker: noir_c
lines.text: That way, wherever and whenever, you can be happy.
Although it wasn't exactly the most verbose statement,
we knew perfectly well what Lumi was trying to say,
and it brought a smile to all of our faces.
And with that, the legend of the hot spring came to an auspicious end.
